## tl;dr

Install crosslink via `cargo install crosslink`, then run `crosslink init` in your project directory to get started.
:::

&nbsp;

## From crates.io

```bash
cargo install crosslink
```

The `crosslink` binary will be available in your PATH after install.

&nbsp;

---

## Build from source

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Corvidae-Coding-Projects/crosslink.git
cd crosslink/crosslink
cargo install --path .
```

Or build without installing:

```bash
cargo build --release
# Binary at target/release/crosslink
```

&nbsp;

---

## VS Code extension

Search **"Crosslink Issue Tracker"** in VS Code Extensions, or visit the [VS Code Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=corvidae-coding-projects.crosslink-issue-tracker).

The extension bundles the CLI binary and provides:

- Command Palette access to all crosslink commands
- Status bar indicator for daemon status
- Auto-starts daemon when a `.crosslink` project is detected
- Cross-platform: Windows, Linux, macOS

&nbsp;

---

## Requirements

- **Rust 1.87+** (for `cargo install`) — [install rustup](https://rustup.rs/)
- **Python 3.6+** — required for Claude Code and Codex hooks
- **Git** — required for multi-agent coordination features
- A normal signed-in **Claude Code** or **Codex** CLI account for autonomous runs

&nbsp;

---

## Initialize a project

After installing, run in any project directory:

```bash
crosslink init
```

The interactive TUI walkthrough guides you through initial configuration — choosing tracking mode, setting up hooks, and configuring agent identity. Sensible defaults are pre-selected so you can accept them all to get started fast.

This sets up `.crosslink/`, both Claude Code and Codex repository integrations,
provider-neutral rules, shared MCP servers, and skills. Install only one side
with `--agent-integration claude|codex`; this controls installed assets and does
not select the runtime provider. See [Claude and Codex providers](../guides/providers.qmd)
and [Your First Agent Session](quickstart.qmd).
